summary: Tested Feb-2026 Celesta Glow follow-up batch (geo proxy, warehouse admin, sale-mode landing banners, /routine mandatory selfie+mobile, /shop anti-aging landing banner, removed public lead-form routes, admin extras Warehouse tab, employee role-based access). Backend 8/8 PASS. Frontend: 4/7 PASS. THREE BLOCKER BUGS on frontend: (1) /admin/extras missing Warehouse tab and still shows Sale Campaigns tab, (2) /routine Generate button has NO validation for selfie or mobile (no alert fires), (3) employee login for emp@celestaglow.com/emp1234 returns 'Invalid username/email or password' from /api/employee/login — blocks role-based access verification.

ui_bugs.issue: Tabs array (lines 25-30) still contains {k:'sales', label:'Sale Campaigns'} and does NOT contain the Warehouse tab. As a result /admin/extras shows 4 tabs [Shop by Category Tiles, Leads, Sale Campaigns, Flat 50% OFF Switch] — Warehouse is missing (data-testid extras-tab-warehouse not found) and Sale Campaigns is still present. The WarehouseTab component IS defined lower in the file (line ~136) with all required data-testids (wh-name, wh-address, wh-pincode, wh-phone, wh-maps, wh-save) but it is never rendered because the tabs list & the switch on line 41-44 don't include 'warehouse'.

handleGenerate() has NO validation for photo or mobile — it directly calls setTimeout and runs product-pick logic. Requirement: clicking generate WITHOUT a selfie should alert; with selfie but no valid mobile should also alert. Neither alert fires (verified: dialog handler saw zero dialogs). Missing block should be: if(!photo) return alert('Please add a selfie'); if(!/^\d{10}$/.test(mobile)) return alert('Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile');

Autocomplete suggestions render (4 button items appear when typing 'kozhikode') but they lack individual data-testid attributes (e.g. location-suggestion-0). Requirement wording only asks for 'suggestion rows' being visible — satisfied — but adding testids would make future E2E stable.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/employee/login returns 401 'Invalid username/email or password'. Credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md do not authenticate. Cannot verify role-based access guard on EmployeeLayout (was the ask). Backend log shows employee_sessions hydrated 0 from Mongo at startup — the seed may not have inserted this account, or the password_hash isn't matching. Suggest re-seeding the emp user with a fresh bcrypt hash for 'emp1234'.

passed_verifications: PUT /api/admin/sale-mode with landing_banner_anti_aging_desktop/mobile persists, public GET /api/sale-mode returns them
POST /api/admin/sale-mode/banner rejects unknown field names (whitelist works)
Homepage location modal auto-opens after localStorage clear + scroll > 40px
Location modal 'kozhikode' input renders 4 clickable suggestion rows within 3s
/routine label reads 'Selfie (required — helps personalize)' and mobile input testid present
/shop?niche=anti-aging: banner container hidden when landing_banner_anti_aging_desktop is empty, VISIBLE () after admin sets URL
Flat 50% OFF tab shows BOTH sections: 'Anti-Aging niche banners' + 'Anti-Aging landing page banner'
Public /partner-with-us, /invest-now, /free-skin-advice all render SPA 404 (0 inputs, no LeadForm content)
Nav header has no <a href> to any of the three removed routes
action_items: AdminExtras.js: replace {k:'sales', label:'Sale Campaigns'} with {k:'warehouse', label:'Warehouse', icon: WarehouseIcon} in the tabs array (lines 25-30), and add `{tab === 'warehouse' && <WarehouseTab auth={auth} />}` in the render switch (lines 41-44). Also delete the now-orphan SalesTab component if not used elsewhere.
RoutinePage.js handleGenerate: add mandatory validation at the top — check `photo` truthy and `mobile` is a 10-digit number, alert & return early otherwise.
Re-seed employee account emp@celestaglow.com with password emp1234 (bcrypt) and permissions={products,retention} so role-based-access can be verified.
OPTIONAL: add data-testid='location-suggestion-N' on autocomplete rows in LocationStrip for stable E2E.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminExtras.js has clear implementation drift — the WarehouseTab component + all its testids were built but never wired into the tabs list. Classic 'forgot to register in the router/switch' bug. This should have been caught by a smoke test opening /admin/extras.

RoutinePage.js handleGenerate contains business logic (product pick + persistence) but no input validation — even the mobile number is captured but never checked. Requirements said BOTH selfie AND mobile are mandatory — right now both are effectively optional and the API POST /api/routines/save may fire with photo_url/photo_data null.
geo.py is well-structured — key is read lazily, uses httpx.AsyncClient with timeout, normalises the messy address_components correctly. No issues.
delivery_men.py warehouse endpoints correctly enforce X-Admin-Token (verified returns 401/403 without header).
test_credentials: Admin X-Admin-Token=celestaglow2024 works. Employee emp@celestaglow.com / emp1234 REJECTED by /api/employee/login (Invalid username/email or password).
seed_data_creation: Set warehouse to TEST_ values during pytest — final state left as TEST_ (main agent can overwrite via UI). Set + cleared landing_banner_anti_aging_desktop back to empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-verify: (a) Warehouse tab visible on /admin/extras with all wh-* testids + save persists via /api/admin/warehouse; (b) /routine Generate button alerts when photo missing AND when mobile is not 10 digits; (c) employee login works with emp@celestaglow.com/emp1234, then /employee/orders redirects to /employee/dashboard, /employee/products stays on route. Note: backend hot-reload triggers on tests/*.py changes and takes ~90s during startup restore — expect first API call to time out after code edits.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 (AdminExtras) RCA: developer built WarehouseTab component (lines 133-235) but never edited the top-level tabs array (line 25-30) or the render switch (line 41-44) to include 'warehouse'. Bug 2 (RoutinePage) RCA: handleGenerate was copied from the pre-mandatory-selfie iteration; validation stub was never added. Bug 3 (Employee login) RCA: likely a bcrypt-hash mismatch OR the seed migration didn't run; backend logs show 'employee_sessions hydrated 0 active sessions from Mongo' at startup which is normal for sessions but doesn't confirm the users collection contains the emp account — needs main-agent inspection.
